title: Stereotactic Radiation Therapy: Stereotactic Radiosurgery (SRS) and Stereotactic Body Radiation Therapy (SBRT)
analysis_of_evidence:
<p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Choroidal Melanoma</strong> </span></p>
<p>The amount of literature submitted was not voluminous, but choroidal melanomas are not very common. Thus, to have large series of patients would not be possible. None of the papers suggest negative results on patients after the use of stereotactic radiosurgery choroidal melanomas and the outcomes were at least as good as other methods. Thus, this contractor will add choroidal melanomas as an indication for Stereotactic Radiosurgery.</p>
